summary.headline: Mars Visibility in the Zodiac
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the eastern and western visibility of Mars in Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, and Scorpio. Hermes assigns differing effects by thirds of each sign, including fires, illness, deaths, drought, rain, royal distress, warfare, miscarriage, and soldiers’ relief.
